scope: One previously unscored native scientific engineering table from the historical ICDAR2013/Camelot fixture set; not a recent-publication business sample, physical scan or held-out estimate. Original published XML span/text labels; no source-label rewrite.
selection: Fixed source/page/region/shape/labels before candidate extraction. Camelot test_lattice identifies the original us-030.pdf page2; published XML gives independent geometric association and rectangular spans.

protocol.extraction: Complete original PDF; score selected source page after extraction, request cell geometry, otherwise default native policies. No OCR/model, cropping, source repair or per-case thresholds.
protocol.association: Maximum source-frame parent ROI IoU >=0.5, stable first-index tie break; source ROI from original region XML, never enters extraction.
protocol.comparison: Exact zero-based row/column/rowSpan/columnSpan keys, ASCII-whitespace-only text collapse, no case/punctuation/numeric changes. Keep missing and extra keys.
protocol.annotation_origin: Original XML row/column labels start at1; subtract common minimum indices, preserve all spans and strings.
protocol.prediction_safety: Do not select a table or rewrite labels based on text similarity.
